data.description: You have learned how to preserve a sample of oozes in a sealed bottle, which you can prepare for use as an extract.  When you activate the extract, you actually throw the bottle at a square within 30 feet, releasing the CR 2 ooze, which reconstitutes and attacks the closest creature.  The ooze is not under your control, but is otherwise treated as a summoned creature.  The ooze remains for %1 rounds, and decays into powder when the duration expires.  If you have the infusion discovery, another character can use the infused specimen.
